fields.title: 📖 Tawḥīd requires rejection of false worship
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever says **Lā ilāha illa Allah** and rejects what is worshipped besides Allah — his blood and his wealth are protected, and his reckoning lies with Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Lā ilāha illa Allah comprises **affirmation for Allah** and **rejection of false worship**.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Īmān, Hadith Nr. 23; überliefert von Ṭāriq ibn Ashyam al-Ashjaʿī.
